words: A player who has just moved up into VVIP (Tier 3 or Tier V). They get a welcome Internal Mail on the day of the upgrade.
The column in the Team Engagement File that holds today's newly upgraded players. Updated daily at 2:00 PM.
The welcome IM subject and content in Template Tab, New Players. The only template for this task.
Person in charge. Here, the VIP CS who looks after the player.
The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Can you send the welcome today?
items: You are on the morning shift
The 2:00 PM list is updated and confirmed by the ATL or above
You are using today's list, not an old one
tour.done: All three: send the welcome IM at 3:00 PM.
tour.notYet: List empty or not confirmed by 2:00 PM: tell the ATL at once. Never send an unconfirmed list.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Five steps
items: Confirm the list
After the 2:00 PM update, check the ATL or above has confirmed it.
Copy the players
Copy the New Welcome Players column. Today's list only.
Get the template
Template Tab, New Players: IM subject and content.
Send at 3:00 PM
IM to every newly upgraded VVIP. Check segment and brand for each player.
QA Record
Attach a BO screenshot.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Send before the ATL or above confirms the list.
Send from an old or unconfirmed list.
Use a template from another campaign.
Hard-sell or push urgency. The welcome is recognition, not pressure.

tour.label: Message
tour.title: What the welcome says
items: Congratulate
Welcome the player to the new tier.
Introduce yourself
You are their VIP CS, their PIC.
What VIP support does
Priority chat, dedicated help, fast issue fixing.
How to reach you
Live Chat and Telegram.
Optional
Ask their preferences: language, contact time, favourite games.

tour.label: Check
tour.title: Segment and brand
tour.q: Do the player's segment and brand match the welcome you are about to send?
tour.no: Stop and fix it first. A mismatched welcome goes to the wrong player or brand.

pool.q: It is 2:45 PM and the upgraded list has not been confirmed by the ATL. What do you do?
o: Tell the ATL and wait; never send an unconfirmed list
pool.why: Do not send until the ATL or above confirms the list. If it is not updated by 2:00 PM, notify the ATL at once.

pool.q: When do you send the welcome IM?
pool.why: The list updates at 2:00 PM; the morning shift sends at 3:00 PM.
Use the New Players template only, never one from another campaign type.

o: Congratulations on your upgrade. I'm your VIP CS; reach me on Live Chat or Telegram.
Claim your bonus before it expires
pool.why: Recognition, not pressure: congratulate, introduce yourself as PIC, explain how to reach you. No urgency or hard-sell.

pool.q: Today's list is empty, but yesterday's had 15 players. What do you do?
o: Tell the ATL; never use an outdated list
pool.why: Always use today's latest list. An empty list goes to the ATL; never send from an old one.

pool.q: Before sending, you notice a player listed under the wrong brand. What now?
o: Fix it first; check segment and brand per player
pool.why: Double-check segment and brand before sending to avoid a mismatched welcome.

pool.q: How does the welcome tell the player to reach you?
pool.why: Explain how to contact the VIP CS: Live Chat and Telegram.
